title: 179. Gen Z Mental Health: The Role of Families, Friends, Schools, ACEs, & More feat. Dr. Jessica Gomez
description_html:
Today's guest is Dr. Jessica Gomez— a bilingual licensed psychologist and executive director of Momentous Institute. Dr. Gomez has over 17 years of experience working to create healthy communities that provide children with access to quality education and mental health services.

Momentous Institute's Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/momentousinstitute/

summary: in this episode, sadie sits down with dr. jessica gomez, a bilingual psychologist and executive director of momentous institute, to talk about the youth mental health crisis and how families, schools, and communities shape teen well-being. they discuss how mental health struggles ripple through entire households, what schools can do to support students beyond academics, and the role of adverse childhood experiences (aces) in long-term mental health. dr. gomez shares practical advice on foundational well-being (sleep, nutrition, movement, community), how to know when to seek professional help, and how teens can support struggling friends without taking on a therapist role. the conversation also explores the pros and cons of normalizing mental health struggles and why education around emotional health should start early.
quote: you don't have to be your friend's therapist. it's not healthy for you either.
